title: SI-UBL 2.0, the Dutch NLCIUS: the UBL invoice and credit note the Dutch government takes
source: SI-UBL 2.0.3.13, the validation artefacts of the Nederlandse Peppol Autoriteit (release of 2026-05-21, commit 4e93ae8681f4): schematron/si-ubl-2.0/si-ubl-2.0-nlcius.sch for the BR-NL rules (BR-NL-1 and -10 the KvK or OIN under 0106 or 0190, BR-NL-2 a buyer or order reference, BR-NL-3 and -4 street, city and postcode, BR-NL-11 and -12 the payment means, and the fields BR-NL-26, -30, -31 and -32 advise against) and xsl/si-ubl-2.0.xsl, fetched at that commit and run in the KoSIT validator (Apache-2.0). Read 2026-10-09.

rules.text: The official SI-UBL 2.0 rules accept an invoice or credit note tagged with the NLCIUS customization; skipped when they are not installed.
